style.styleTitle: Personalised Message Rocking Horse Snow Globe by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Capture the magic of the season with this charming snow globe, expertly crafted from plastic and resin. Inside, a delightful mix of fake snow and glitter creates a sparkling winter wonderland that twinkles with every shake. The base can be personalised with an engraved message, adding a heartfelt touch to this enchanting keepsake. Standing 10 cm tall and measuring 8 cm in width and depth, this snow globe is the perfect festive addition to any home or a thoughtful personalised gift for loved ones. Height: 100mm. Width: 80mm. Depth: 80mm.
